# Abdullah Nadeem Portfolio
> Full-Stack MERN Developer & React Expert

Abdullah Nadeem is a Full-Stack Web Developer specializing in MERN Stack, React.js, Next.js, and TypeScript. He builds high-performance, SEO-friendly web applications with clean architecture and exceptional user experiences.

## Technical Skills
- Frontend: React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, TailwindCSS, Three.js, GSAP 
- Backend: Node.js, Express.js
- Database: MongoDB, PostgreSQL
- Specialties: MERN Stack, SEO, Digital Marketing, Immersive Web Experiences, 3D Web Graphics, UI/UX
